newsitem.title: UK: UK TV licence crackdown raises 25 mln stg for BBC.
newsitem.headline: UK TV licence crackdown raises 25 mln stg for BBC.

text.p: Britain's Post Office said on Tuesday a crackdown against television licence cheats had raised a net 25 million stg for the BBC in the last 12 months.
The Post Office, which collects the fee used to fund public broadcasting, said the crackdown had already resulted in 130,000 people buying or renewing their licences.
The BBC has been developing its commercial activities but still derives some 1.8 billion stg -- 95 percent of its revenue -- from the annual licence fee payable by all television set owners.
The annual fee for a colour television is 91.50 stg. Fines for non-payment can reach as high as 1,000 stg and around 1,000 licence evaders were caught every day last year, the Post Office said.
